ideas.pitch: A 2D terminal-style dungeon crawler where players program autonomous Python scripts to navigate rooms, demonstrating logic-based gameplay inspired by CodeCombat.
ideas.title: CodeQuest Arena: Procedural Python Roguelike
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning pattern from similar hackathons by integrating local simulation and script-based bot control, appealing directly to the CS student judges from SIT's 32BIT club.

ideas.pitch: An educational narrative game built in Ren'Py focused on local water management challenges in Karnataka, featuring interactive branching dialogue and decision trees.
ideas.title: WaterWise Chronicles: Local Impact Visual Novel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows a first-prize winning formula from similar public-good gaming hackathons by using a localized narrative framework to address real regional resource issues.

ideas.pitch: A tightly scoped 2D pixel-art platformer built in Unity where two players must share a single keyboard to coordinate mechanics and solve spatial puzzles.
ideas.title: Echoes of Incarnia: Co-op 2D Platformer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the short 8-hour window by focusing on tight, polished core mechanics and immediate local multiplayer fun that judges can play live during evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A fast-paced local multiplayer party game where players engage in trust-building and betrayal mini-games, tracking an emergent deception metric.
ideas.title: Split or Steal: Prisoner's Dilemma Party Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates a complex multi-agent simulation concept into an accessible, highly entertaining party game that guarantees a lively and memorable live demo for the judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Godot plugin allowing indie game developers to chat with random dungeon NPCs in real time via local LLMs or lightweight API calls.
ideas.title: Realm Weaver: AI-Driven NPC Dialogue Addon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering within hours by bridging a game engine runtime to a live language interface, providing high novelty value for a game dev club hackathon.
